description: Update PRs for the base image's digest, the workflows' actions, and the cosign and Trivy versions; minor and patch updates come together in one PR on Monday mornings. Nothing merges by itself, and Renovate never asks GitHub to auto-merge.

packageRules.description: GHCR gives image digests no release date, so the base image's updates can't wait 14 days: review and the PR's Image tests are the gate.
Minor and patch updates come together in one PR on Monday mornings, so merging them publishes one image a week, not one per update. Majors and the base image's digest keep their own PRs.

customManagers.description: Tool versions in the workflows, marked with a '# renovate:' comment.
